extra.label_text: This code was written by Gemini.
issues: The solution relies on finding a prime of the form kN+1 below 10^18, but this is not guaranteed by the problem constraints and may raise RuntimeError for a valid input.
The prime search loop has no deterministic time bound suitable for competitive programming worst cases.
The random search for an element of exact order N is also an unbounded loop, even though the seed is fixed.
